title: aster cuneatus
intro: Aster cuneatus, commonly known as Wedge-leaved Aster, is a flowering plant species belonging to the daisy family. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal disorders, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Aster cuneatus include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties, which help in reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
